scope: CPU-only standalone closure pilot; no production integration, default change, GPU run, or large-supercell execution.

method.reciprocal_translation: u=exp(-i k.r) phi; IFFT[exp(-i G.tau) FFT(u)]; phi_tau=exp(-i k.tau) exp(+i k.r) u_tau
method.target_grid_closure: evaluate the primitive seed and reciprocal translation on the commensurate 2x mesh, then select the target-grid lattice points
method.not_claimed: The 2x mesh is a convergence closure, not an exact interpolation theorem or production selector design.

target_grid_parity.metric_assembly: all complex AO-group contributions are summed before abs-squared

on_demand_measurement.definition: Each pivot-column group request regenerates its translated 2x-grid AO group from a separately built primitive seed; no generated group is reused.

seed_build.definition: Three k-resolved primitive AO seeds are evaluated at 2x resolution before any timed regeneration.

rank_projection.definition: Temporal projection from the measured 211 three-k sweep only; not a 444 execution forecast.

live_state_accounting.test_k_handling: The 211 test intentionally retains three k-resolved 2x seeds for parity and is therefore not k-streamed.
live_state_accounting.model_boundary: These are explicit NumPy-array residency models, not allocator/RSS measurements or a production selector memory claim.

projected_444.k_streaming: not executed; the projection gives both a one-k streamed generated-group state and the 64-k retained-seed alternative
projected_444.model_boundary: The 444 values are linear array-size accounting only; no 444 run or k-streaming implementation was performed.

conclusion: The 2x commensurate closure removes the target-grid aliasing observed at 1x for this pilot and reproduces target-grid AO, three metric columns, and the rank-16 deterministic pivot prefix. The measured pivot path separately builds and retains three seeds for the test, then regenerates once for the diagonal and once per pivot. Its explicit temporal and live-array models, together with the unchanged dense-L requirement, do not justify production integration.
